Activity History - Disable
items.description: Stops Windows from publishing or uploading user activities while preserving clipboard history.

items.title: Hibernation - Disable
items.description: Hibernation is really meant for laptops as it saves what's in memory before turning the PC off. It really should never be used.

items.title: Widgets - Remove
items.description: Removes the annoying widgets in the bottom left of the Taskbar.

items.title: Start Menu Previous Layout - Enable
items.description: Bring back the old Start Menu layout from before the gradual rollout of the new one in 25H2. On newer versions of Windows !!THIS TWEAK WILL NOT WORK!!

items.title: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable
items.description: Will not display recommended Microsoft Store apps when searching for apps in the Start menu.

items.title: Location Tracking - Disable
items.description: Disables Location Tracking.

items.title: Services - Set to Manual
items.description: Sets some services to Manual startup.

items.title: svchost.exe Splitting - Disable
items.description: Disables service-host splitting to reduce the number of svchost.exe processes and modestly lower memory overhead. Recommended for low-performance systems with 12 GB of RAM or less. Can interfere with Xbox services. Restart Windows after changing this setting.

items.title: Brave Browser - Debloat
items.description: Disables various annoyances like Brave Rewards, Leo AI, Crypto Wallet and VPN.

items.title: RDP Unsigned File Warnings - Disable
items.description: Disables warnings shown when launching unsigned RDP files introduced with the latest Windows 10 and 11 updates.

items.title: Microsoft Edge - Debloat
items.description: Disables various telemetry options, popups, and other annoyances in Edge.

items.title: ConsumerFeatures - Disable
items.description: Stops promoted app installs and reduces app suggestions from Microsoft Store content.

items.title: Telemetry - Disable
items.description: Disables Microsoft Telemetry.

items.title: Delivery Optimization - Disable
items.description: Stops Windows from using your bandwidth to upload updates to other PCs on the internet or local network.

items.title: Microsoft Edge - Remove
items.description: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge by creating dummy MicrosoftEdge.exe file in the legacy Edge folder. This tricks Windows into unlocking the official Edge uninstaller allowing for a system-level removal.

items.title: BitLocker - Disable
items.description: Disables BitLocker.

items.title: Date & Time - Set Time to UTC
items.description: Essential for computers that are dual booting. Fixes the time sync with Linux systems.

items.title: Microsoft OneDrive - Remove
items.description: Denies permission to remove OneDrive user files, then uses its own uninstaller to remove it and restores the original permission afterward.

items.title: File Explorer Home and Gallery - Disable
items.description: Removes the Home and Gallery from Explorer and sets This PC as default.

items.title: Visual Effects - Set to Best Performance
items.description: Sets the system preferences to performance. You can do this manually with sysdm.cpl as well.

items.title: Disable Reserved Storage
items.description: Disables Windows Reserved Storage (7-10 GB held for updates/temp files). Recommended only on small drives. Re-enable before major Windows feature updates to avoid installation failures.

items.title: Restore Point - Create
items.description: Creates a restore point at runtime in case a revert is needed from WinUtil modifications.

items.title: End Task With Right Click - Enable
items.description: Enables option to end task when right-clicking a program in the taskbar.

items.title: Storage Sense - Disable
items.description: Storage Sense deletes temp files automatically.

items.title: Windows AI - Disable And Remove
items.description: Removes and disables all AI features/packages

items.title: Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) - Disable
items.description: If enabled, WPBT allows your computer vendor to execute programs at boot time, such as anti-theft software, software drivers, as well as force install software without user consent. Poses potential security risk.

items.title: Prevent Device Companion Apps
items.description: Prevents additional software from being installed when plugging in devices (e.g. Ads when plugging in a monitor). Poses potential security risk.

items.title: Razer Software Auto-Install - Disable
items.description: Blocks ALL Razer Software installations. The hardware works fine without any software.

items.title: Logitech Download Assistant Auto-Install - Disable
items.description: Blocks the Logi Download Assistant that Windows Update keeps reinstalling with Logitech device drivers. Logitech hardware keeps working without it.

items.title: System Tray Notifications & Calendar - Disable
items.description: Disables all Notifications INCLUDING Calendar.

items.title: Adobe URL Block List - Enable
items.description: Reduces user interruptions by selectively blocking connections to Adobe's activation and telemetry servers. Credit: Ruddernation-Designs

items.title: Right-Click Menu Previous Layout - Enable
items.description: Restores the classic context menu when right-clicking in File Explorer, replacing the simplified Windows 11 version.

items.title: Disk Cleanup - Run
items.description: Runs Disk Cleanup on Drive C: and removes old Windows Updates.

items.title: Temporary Files - Remove
items.description: Erases TEMP Folders.

items.title: IPv6 - Set IPv4 as Preferred
items.description: Setting the IPv4 preference can have latency and security benefits on private networks where IPv6 is not configured.

items.title: Teredo - Disable
items.description: Teredo network tunneling is an IPv6 feature that can cause additional latency, but may cause problems with some games.

items.title: IPv6 - Disable
items.description: Disables IPv6.

items.title: Background Apps - Disable
items.description: Disables all Microsoft Store apps from running in the background, which has to be done individually since Windows 11.

items.title: Disable USB Power Saving
items.description: Disables USB selective suspend and USB root power saving to reduce controller wake latency during gaming.

items.title: Disable Power Throttling
items.description: Turns off Windows power throttling and USB power-drain recovery behavior so foreground workloads can stay responsive.

items.title: Disable Menu Show Delay
items.description: Controls the delay before menus appear after a mouse hover. Disabling this feature can make the menus open instantly, improving responsiveness but may reduce user control.

items.title: Disable Mouse Hover Time
items.description: Adjusts the time the system waits before triggering a hover event. Disabling this may speed up interactions but can lead to unintentional activations.

items.title: Optimize Keyboard Latency
items.description: Sets the keyboard repeat delay to the lowest value and keeps repeat speed at maximum for more responsive input.

items.title: Disable Mouse Acceleration
items.description: Turns off Windows pointer acceleration so mouse movement stays consistent for games and precision input.

items.title: Disable Auto Complete
items.description: Disables automatic suggestions while typing in certain fields, such as search boxes and form inputs. Disabling it can reduce distractions but may slow down workflow.

items.title: Disable Window Shake
items.description: Disables the window shake feature that minimizes all open windows when you shake a window. Disabling it improves focus but removes a handy window management tool.

items.title: Enable Global Timer Resolution
items.description: Allows applications to request higher timer resolution globally, reducing scheduling latency for games and real-time audio.

items.title: Disable HPET
items.description: Disables the High Precision Event Timer and switches to TSC for lower latency timing. Requires a reboot.

items.title: Disable Dynamic Tick
items.description: Forces the system timer to fire at a constant rate instead of dynamically adjusting, reducing jitter in latency-sensitive workloads.

items.title: Disable SysMain
items.description: Turns off SysMain, which preloads frequently used applications for faster startup. May impact startup times for some programs if you're using HDD.

items.title: Disable Prefetch & Superfetch
items.description: Disables Windows Prefetcher and Superfetch preloading to free RAM and reduce disk I/O. Recommended for SSD users.

items.title: Enable Large System Cache
items.description: Allocates more system memory for file caching, improving disk read performance for file-heavy workloads.

items.title: Disable Network Data Usage Monitor
items.description: Disables the NDU service which is known to cause non-paged pool memory leaks on some systems over extended uptime.

items.title: Disable Page File Encryption
items.description: Disables encryption of the Windows page file to reduce CPU overhead during paging operations.

items.title: Enable Gaming Mode
items.description: Enables Gaming Mode, which optimizes system resources for a smoother gaming experience. May affect background processes.

items.title: Enable Fullscreen Optimizations
items.description: Lets Windows use its fullscreen optimization path for games. Disable this toggle only for games that need exclusive fullscreen behavior.

items.title: GPU Driver Performance Tweaks
items.description: Applies AMD, NVIDIA, and Intel registry tweaks to reduce GPU power-state switching and display latency.

items.title: Optimize System Profile
items.description: Enhances your system's performance by adjusting system profile settings. This feature prioritize speed and efficiency, improving overall system responsiveness and resource management.

items.title: Optimize NTFS Settings
items.description: Tune NTFS settings to improve performance and enhance privacy.

items.title: Optimize Foreground App Performance
items.description: Boosts performance for active applications by prioritizing foreground tasks.

items.title: Enable Low Disk Space Checks
items.description: Enables automatic checks for low disk space to prevent performance issues. Disabling it could reduce notifications, but you may miss critical storage warnings.

items.title: Hide File Extensions and Hidden Files
items.description: Controls the visibility of file extensions and hidden files. Enabling this reduces clutter but hides important file details.

items.title: Disable Link Resolve
items.description: Disables the resolution of broken links in files and folders. Disabling it can speed up operations but may leave outdated links unresolved.

items.title: Disable Background Apps
items.description: Prevents the apps from running in the background, leading to enhanced performance in some cases.

items.title: Disable Crash Dump
items.description: Controls whether crash reports and memory dumps are generated when applications crash. Disabling this feature can help preserve disk space, but may reduce the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot application issues.

items.title: Disable Remote Assistance
items.description: Disables remote support features, allowing others to assist you via remote desktop. Disabling it can improve security but limits support options.

items.title: Disable Remote Registry
items.description: Disables access to the registry remotely. Disabling it improves security but prevents remote configuration of registry settings.

items.title: Disable Service Host Splitting
items.description: Disables Service Host splitting for much lower RAM usage and process count.

items.title: Adjust Task Timeouts
items.description: Modifies the timeout settings for system tasks. Adjusting it can improve performance in some scenarios but may cause tasks to fail under certain conditions.

items.title: Decrease Service Timeouts
items.description: Adjusts the timeouts for system services. Shortening these can improve performance but may cause services to terminate prematurely.

items.title: Add Copy/Move Context Menu
items.description: Enables additional options in the file context menu to easily copy or move files to a new location. This feature streamlines file management by providing quick access to these functions directly from the right-click menu.

items.title: Disable WPBT Execution
items.description: Stop firmware from running programs (e.g., OEM bloatware) during startup.

items.title: Enable Legacy Boot Menu
items.description: Switch to the legacy boot menu for faster startup.

items.title: Disable System Restore
items.description: Disables System Restore, which creates restore points to revert the system to a previous state in case of problems. Not recommended. Disabling this feature removes the ability to easily recover from potential system issues.

items.title: Disable Cortana
items.description: Disables Cortana, the virtual assistant that can answer questions and complete tasks. May impact voice search and some productivity features.

items.title: Disable Store Updates
items.description: Disables automatic updates for apps downloaded from the Microsoft Store. May leave apps vulnerable to security risks or lacking new features.

items.title: Disable Smart Screen
items.description: Turns off SmartScreen Filter, which warns you about potentially unsafe apps and files downloaded from the internet. Disabling this feature increases the risk of malware infection.

items.title: Exclude Drivers From Windows Updates
items.description: Excludes driver updates from Windows Update. May lead to outdated drivers with potential security risks or compatibility issues. Use with caution.

items.title: Disable Windows Transparency
items.description: Disables transparent effects in system UI elements like the taskbar and windows, improving performance

items.title: Enable Windows Dark Mode
items.description: Enables dark mode for the entire system without the need to activate Windows

items.title: Enable Verbose Logon
items.description: Enable detailed logon messages for better system monitoring and troubleshooting. May not be user-friendly for everyday use

items.title: Disable Home Group
items.description: Turns off Home Group to stop sharing files and printers with other devices on the network

items.title: Disable Print Service
items.description: Disables the printing service, preventing print-related functionalities

items.title: Disable Compatibility Assistant
items.description: Turns off Compatibility Assistant to disable automatic compatibility checks for programs

items.title: Disable Search
items.description: Turns off system-wide search functionality

items.title: Disable Fax Service
items.description: Disables the Fax service in Windows

items.title: Disable Insider Service
items.description: Opt-out of Windows Insider Program and stop receiving preview builds

items.title: Disable Hibernation
items.description: Turn off hibernation to save power and prevent the computer from entering sleep mode. Not recommended for laptops

items.title: Disable Sticky Keys
items.description: Disables Sticky Keys accessibility feature. Useful for people who accidentally press multiple keys at once

items.title: Disable Windows Ink
items.description: Turns off Windows Ink Workspace and related features. Not recommended for devices with a stylus

items.title: Disable Spelling and Typing Features
items.description: Disables spelling and typing suggestions

items.title: Disable Cloud Clipboard
items.description: Disables Cloud Clipboard feature for cross-device clipboard sharing

items.title: Disable Quick Access History
items.description: Disables recording and display of Quick Access history

items.title: Disable My People
items.description: Turns off My People feature in the taskbar

items.title: Disable Cast to Device
items.description: Disables the Cast to Device feature in Windows. Useful for presentations or sharing media on other devices

items.title: Disable Error Reporting
items.description: Turns off error reporting to prevent the automatic sending of error reports to Microsoft

items.title: Disable Game Bar
items.description: Turns off the Game Bar and its associated features

items.title: Disable Lock Screen Notifications
items.description: Prevents toast notifications from appearing on the lock screen for improved privacy and fewer distractions.

items.title: Disable All Toast Notifications
items.description: Completely disables all pop-up toast notifications from apps and the system.

items.title: Disable Notification Center
items.description: Removes the Notification Center (Action Center) from the taskbar. Requires Explorer restart.

items.title: Disable Suggested Actions
items.description: Disables the smart clipboard suggested actions flyout that appears when copying dates, phone numbers, or addresses.

items.title: Enable Classic Context Menu
items.description: Restores the classic context menu style of Windows 10, providing a familiar right-click menu experience with all options displayed immediately

items.title: Disable Recommended Section In Start Menu
items.description: Removes the "Recommended" section from the Start Menu to provide a cleaner and more focused layout.

items.title: Move Taskbar to The Left
items.description: Moves the taskbar from the default bottom position to the left side of the screen. Personal preference

items.title: Disable Snap Assist
items.description: Disables Snap Assist, which automatically arranges open windows when dragging. Useful for multitasking but some users prefer manual window management

items.title: Disable Widgets
items.description: Disables the Widgets feature on the Windows 11 taskbar. Consider if you find the widgets useful for quick updates (Windows 11 only)

items.title: Disable Chat
items.description: Disables the Chat feature on the Windows 11 taskbar. Only recommended if you don't use the chat feature for communication (Windows 11 only)

items.title: Enable Files Compact Mode
items.description: Enables Compact Mode for file browsing with smaller thumbnails. Useful for low-resolution displays or managing large folders

items.title: Enable EndTask
items.description: Enables an option when right clicking on apps' icons in the taskbar, allowing you to quickly terminate unresponsive applications without opening Task Manager.

items.title: Disable Stickers
items.description: Disables the Stickers feature in the Windows 11 messaging app. Only recommended if you don't use stickers for communication (Windows 11 only)

items.title: Disable CoPilot AI
items.description: Disables the CoPilot AI feature in Windows for assistance with code writing. Not recommended for developers

items.title: Disable Windows Recall
items.description: Disables Windows Recall, which captures on-screen activity for AI-powered search. Recommended for privacy-conscious users and secure environments.

items.title: Disable Windows AI
items.description: Strips AI features from Notepad, Paint, and Photos, disables Windows Studio camera/mic effects and Gaming AI, and removes AI shell integrations to maximize privacy and performance.

items.title: Disable Edge Discover Bar
items.description: Disables the Discover Bar feature in Microsoft Edge. Useful if you find it distracting or prefer cleaner browser interface

items.title: Disable VBS
items.description: Disables Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) for advanced security features. Not recommended for high-security environments

items.title: Add "Take Ownership" to Context Menu
items.description: Adds a "Take Ownership" option to the right-click context menu for files and folders, allowing quick ownership transfer.

items.title: Add "Open Command Prompt Here"
items.description: Adds an "Open Command Prompt Here" option to the folder background right-click context menu.

items.title: Add "Copy File Path" to Context Menu
items.description: Adds a "Copy File Path" option to the right-click context menu for quick path copying to clipboard.

items.title: Disable Advertising ID
items.description: Disables the Advertising ID, preventing Windows from tracking your activities for targeted advertising. This can enhance privacy but may affect app experiences.

items.title: Disable Bluetooth Advertising
items.description: Turns off Bluetooth advertising, which broadcasts your device's presence to other nearby devices. Disabling this can reduce privacy risks.

items.title: Disable News and Interests
items.description: Disables the News and Interests feed on the taskbar, which displays news, weather, and other updates. Disabling this may improve system performance.

items.title: Disable Spotlight Features
items.description: Turns off the Spotlight feature that shows personalized content and recommendations on your lock screen. Disabling this feature can help protect privacy.

items.title: Disable Tailored Experiences
items.description: Disables tailored experiences across apps and services, preventing Windows from collecting your preferences and activity data.

items.title: Disable Cloud Optimized Content
items.description: Disables cloud-optimized content, which may include app updates and file syncing. This can reduce internet bandwidth usage but may limit functionality.

items.title: Disable Feedback Notifications
items.description: Prevents Windows from showing feedback notifications related to your experience with the OS. Disabling this feature may reduce interruptions.

items.title: Disable Telemetry Services
items.description: Turns off telemetry services to prevent the collection and transmission of usage data by the operating system.

items.title: Disable Edge Telemetry
items.description: Disables telemetry data collection in Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Disable Visual Studio Telemetry
items.description: Disables telemetry data collection in Visual Studio.

items.title: Disable Nvidia Telemetry
items.description: Disables telemetry data collection by Nvidia drivers.

items.title: Disable Chrome Telemetry
items.description: Disables telemetry data collection in Google Chrome.

items.title: Disable Firefox Telemetry
items.description: Disables telemetry data collection in Mozilla Firefox.

items.title: Disable Diagnostics Toast
items.description: Turns off diagnostic toast notifications, preventing Windows from showing you prompts related to system health or errors. This can help reduce distractions.

items.title: Disable Handwriting Data Sharing
items.description: Turns off the sharing of handwriting data with Microsoft services, improving privacy but reducing some features related to handwriting recognition.

items.title: Disable Text Input Data Collection
items.description: Disables the collection of text input data, preventing Windows from storing and analyzing what you type. This helps protect privacy but may reduce typing accuracy improvements.

items.title: Disable Input Personalization
items.description: Disables personalization of input methods, including predictive text and autocorrect features. This may reduce system performance improvements in text input.

items.title: Disable Online Speech Privacy
items.description: Disables online speech privacy, preventing Windows from storing or processing voice commands. This increases privacy but limits voice features like voice search and commands.

items.title: Disable Safe Search Mode
items.description: Turns off Safe Search Mode, which filters out potentially harmful or inappropriate content from search results. Disabling this increases the risk of exposure to unsafe content.

items.title: Disable Clipboard Sync
items.description: Disables clipboard synchronization across your devices, ensuring your copied data stays local and preventing data from being shared with other devices.

items.title: Disable Message Sync
items.description: Prevents messages from syncing across devices, ensuring your text messages and notifications are only available on the device you are using.

items.title: Disable Setting Sync
items.description: Disables synchronization of system settings across devices. This prevents your device settings, themes, and other configurations from being shared.

items.title: Disable CDP (Customer Data Platform)
items.description: Disables CDP, preventing the collection and use of your data by the customer data platform for analysis and targeted recommendations. This increases privacy but may limit personalization.

items.title: Disable Location Features
items.description: Disables all location-based features on your device, including location services for apps and security features. This can enhance privacy but reduce the functionality of location-dependent services.

items.title: Disable Biometrics features
items.description: Disables the use of biometrics for authentication, such as fingerprint or facial recognition.

items.title: Disable Find My Device
items.description: Disables the Find My Device feature, which helps locate your device if lost. Disabling this reduces your ability to recover a lost device but enhances privacy.

items.title: Disable Voice Activation
items.description: Disables voice activation features like Cortana, preventing the assistant from listening for your voice commands. This can improve privacy but reduces voice command functionality.

items.title: Disable Automatic Restart Sign-On
items.description: Disables automatic sign-on after a restart, requiring you to enter your credentials manually. This may enhance security but adds an extra step to logging in.

items.title: Disable SMBv1
items.description: Disables Server Message Block version 1 (SMBv1) for enhanced security. Recommended

items.title: Disable SMBv2
items.description: Disables Server Message Block version 2 (SMBv2) for enhanced security. Use with caution as it might break network file sharing functionalities.

items.title: Disable Wi-Fi Sense
items.description: Disables automatic connection to suggested open Wi-Fi hotspots and shared networks from contacts.

items.title: Disable Web Results in Search
items.description: Prevents Windows Search from sending queries to Bing and displaying web results. Keeps search local and private.

items.title: Disable App Launch Tracking
items.description: Stops Windows from tracking which apps you launch for personalization of the Start menu's Most Used list.

items.title: Disable Timeline & Activity History
items.description: Disables Windows Timeline activity feed and prevents activity data from being published or uploaded to the cloud.

items.title: Windows Updates
items.description: Configure how Windows handles automatic updates. Choose between automatic updates, security-only, manual control, or completely disabled.

items.title: Reset DNS to DHCP (adapter)
commands: netsh interface ipv4 set dnsservers "{nic}" dhcp
netsh interface ipv6 set dnsservers "{nic}" dhcp

inputValidation.nic: must equal the name of an existing network adapter (enumerated at runtime); reject " & | < > ^ % and CR/LF

items.title: CHKDSK /f on next boot (system drive)
items.note: {DriveRoot} = system drive root, e.g. C:\ (as RyTuneX)
